script_text: Pisces, this week the cosmos is rewriting your love story and your bank balance simultaneously. Early week, Mercury in your 7th House forms a trine with Jupiter, opening doors in partnerships and negotiations from Monday through Wednesday — Wednesday is your absolute power day because Venus conjuncts your natal Moon in the 5th House, igniting romance and creative fire. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday when Mars squares your 10th House, creating career tension that demands patience. By Friday through Sunday, Neptune — your ruling planet — sextiles the Sun in your 2nd House, bringing unexpected financial clarity and a deep intuitive knowing about your worth. Your worst day is Thursday due to that Mars square triggering workplace friction. Your best day is Wednesday when Venus lights up your love sector. This week, Pisces, trust your water-sign intuition before signing anything. Follow for daily updates.
